MERGE INTO SEARCH_KEYWORD_HISTORY TARGET USING ( SELECT #{memberNo} AS MEMBER_NO, #{keyword} AS KEYWORD FROM DUAL ) SOURCE ON ( TARGET.MEMBER_NO = SOURCE.MEMBER_NO AND UPPER(TARGET.KEYWORD) = UPPER(SOURCE.KEYWORD) )
WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TARGET.SEARCH_COUNT = TARGET.SEARCH_COUNT + 1, TARGET.LAST_SEARCHED_AT = SYSDATE
WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( SEARCH_HISTORY_NO, MEMBER_NO, KEYWORD, SEARCH_COUNT, FIRST_SEARCHED_AT, LAST_SEARCHED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_SEARCH_KEYWORD_HISTORY_NO.NEXTVAL, SOURCE.MEMBER_NO, SOURCE.KEYWORD, 1, SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SEARCH_HISTORY_NO AS searchHistoryNo, MEMBER_NO AS memberNo, KEYWORD AS keyword, SEARCH_COUNT AS searchCount, FIRST_SEARCHED_AT AS firstSearchedAt, LAST_SEARCHED_AT AS lastSearchedAt FROM SEARCH_KEYWORD_HISTORY WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} ORDER BY LAST_SEARCHED_AT DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
